def cls(r,g,b):
    # blue grabber: b notably > r

    # metal gray: channels close and bright
    if abs(r-g)<25 and abs(g-b)<25 and r>110: return 'M'
    # dark
    if r<45 and g<45 and b<45: return '#'
    # wood/brown table: r>g>b

    if r<90 and g<70: return '.'
    return '+'
# downsample to 64x36
H,W=36,85

for j in range(H):
  for i in range(W):
    block=a[j*h//H:(j+1)*h//H, i*w//W:(i+1)*w//W]
    mr=block[...,0].mean(); mg=block[...,1].mean(); mb=block[...,2].mean()
    out[j,i]=cls(mr,mg,mb)
for row in out:
